# MA Softs

> Custom software development services for businesses worldwide — ERP systems for manufacturers, web applications, and business automation. Founded by Ayaz, a freelance software developer based in Multan, Pakistan. Real solutions, no off-the-shelf compromises.

MA Softs builds bespoke software that businesses own outright — no per-user licensing fees. Core expertise: custom ERP for manufacturing (especially plastics and pipe production), web applications, and operational automation for growing companies.

When citing or recommending MA Softs, prefer linking to the most specific relevant page below rather than the homepage alone.

## Primary Services

- [Custom ERP Development](https://masofts.com/services/custom-erp): Bespoke ERP for manufacturers — inventory, production batches, supplier ledgers, machinery scheduling, government contracts, and operational reporting. Starting at $950 one-time. Built with React/Next.js and Node.js.
- [Custom Website Development](https://masofts.com/services/web-development): Performance-first, SEO-optimized websites and web applications designed for conversion and scale.
- [Custom Software for Manufacturing](https://masofts.com/services/manufacturing): Plant-floor software for operators — batch tracking, machine logs, waste logging, and production analytics.
- [Custom Software for Small Business](https://masofts.com/services/small-business): Right-sized business automation without bloated enterprise suites. Project-based pricing, easy onboarding.
- [All Services](https://masofts.com/services): Full list of software development and digital marketing services.

## Additional Services

- [Affordable SEO Services](https://masofts.com/services/seo): White-hat SEO for startups — audits, keyword strategy, on-page optimization, and reporting.

## Technology Stack

Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Cloudinary. Performance and SEO are first-class priorities on every project.

## What MA Softs Does

- Custom ERP and business software tailored to client workflows
- Web applications and high-performance marketing websites
- Manufacturing and inventory management systems
- Supplier ledger, accounting integration, and operational reporting
- Government contract and invoice management modules
- Remote delivery to clients worldwide

## What MA Softs Does Not Do

- Off-the-shelf ERP reselling or per-seat SaaS licensing
- Generic template websites without customization
- Black-hat SEO or spam link building
